source.coverage: Visible variants checked against the three user screenshots and cached properties. Complete per-variant property and original-image export remains partial.
source.access: No new Figma calls for this correction. The earlier single quota-limited P2 collection attempt is retained in the access log.

option.note: Hover uses an outer box-shadow to preserve layout dimensions while reproducing the expanded source outline.

multiSwitch.note: Children hug label content; no shared rounded frame or gray track.

chip.note: Source cap trimming is preserved when supported; root size-specific circle vectors are scaled inside their slots without editing SVG bytes.

alert.note: The 20 px leading icon in L leaves 200 px for the source sentence at 292 px outer width. Long text may increase height.

dialog.note: Compact variant uses flex column gaps, zero body margins and equal actions. Native dialog is hidden until open; viewport width remains constrained.

breadcrumbs.separator: Original calendar-next-m.svg reused as a neutral/500 CSS mask; not a text character.
breadcrumbs.note: Text cap trimming follows the source. Wrapping and full-line-height fallbacks preserve narrow viewport behavior.

behavior.selection: CSS-only native checkbox/radio; checked, keyboard grouping, FormData, validation, disabled fieldsets and reset remain native.
behavior.dismissal: Existing initComponents delegates data-af-dismiss for chips/alerts and transfers focus to a neighboring dismiss button when present.
behavior.dialog: Existing native dialog, Escape and focus-return behavior. Slots add styling without a new initializer.
behavior.navigation: Named nav, ol and native links; aria-current=page marks the current item; aria-current=false stays inactive.

assets.usage: Original local circle vectors reused for all semantic sizes. Alert L intentionally uses M 20 px leading vectors.
Original 24 px vector with 4 px inset; mask size accounts for each reference close mark. Pointer area extends invisibly by 6 px (4 px in Dialog).
Original local chevron reused for Breadcrumbs; SVG bytes remain unchanged.

webDecisions: Default feedback colors now match the supplied reference. The previous automatic contrast correction no longer replaces the source appearance.
Opt-in af-chip--accessible and af-alert--accessible retain darker readable semantic text roles. Source colors, especially green/orange, do not meet AA text contrast on their pale fills.
af-link--accessible provides darker default text. af-link--inline restores blue underlined inline links when needed.
No AFDocument fields, runtime dependencies, architecture changes or public JS initializer.
Native checked controls own selected state. Source-like cap trimming has a full-line-height browser fallback.
correctedPreviousAssumptions: Removed the Multi-switch gray track/shared border and equal stretching.
Restored 16 px Regular Option text and transparent unselected/disabled states.
Restored bright semantic source colors, semantic glyphs and small Chip close marks.
Corrected Alert L leading icon rather than expanding the reference width.
Restored Dialog section gaps, equal full-width buttons and subtle shadow.
Replaced blue underlined default links and Unicode Breadcrumbs separators with source states and vector chevrons.
gaps: Original attachment bytes are not available as local files. No PNG checksum or automated source-image pixel diff is claimed.
Detailed per-variant Figma contexts and dedicated P2 SVG exports remain incomplete.
Browser images in artifacts/p2-correction-2026-10-22 are implementation evidence, not original Figma screenshots.
